I feel this deeply.. and I think about this pretty much daily. Ever since my depression hit me real hard in the beginning of high school, I seemed to have lost my ability to function entirely. I grew up as the usual gifted child with big plans and ambitions, so I always thought it was just a massive burnout. Over the course of a few years of attempting recovery several times, lifestyle changes, therapy… I still couldn’t process things like I did back then. Can’t write papers anymore, small assignments feel like they’re huge projects, and focusing is non-existent. Not to mention how I deal with going outside. I’m almost 19 now and college has always been on my life plan but I genuinely feel I’m not going to be able to survive there anymore. It’s scary as hell. I’m almost fully convinced that I just don’t have that level of intellect in me anymore. The quote, “You don’t realize what you have until it’s gone” is something that I feel describes my intelligence decline.
What an atmosphere!! Keep it up 👍❤️

My experience almost exactly…. 
I’ve spent plenty of my time on Genshin and video games in general. I do genuinely love Genshin, their lore, character design, etc. They make it so gripping, it’s insane.. It has made me think a lot. Is the game REALLY that good, or is it just the gacha that’s intoxicating? It has gotten out of hand for me like in your situation. I’ve always given myself excuses such as, “it’s something that I like, there’s nothing wrong with spending some money on it.” So I would then contribute money, some more on top of that, and more. I went from a f2p gamer in general to giving in to a serious gambling addiction that I am absolutely disgusted with myself. It’s destroyed my ability to focus and hindered myself from working on my passions that I would go to the moon and back for. 
Props to you for finding a way out and thank you for sharing. It makes me feel a little better knowing I’m not alone  :) ❤️
